name: ramble-on-server
description: Local MCP server for the Ramble On skill: Notion KB context, voice-model retrieval, and AI-provider translation, transcription, and video tools.

notion_api_key.title: Notion integration token
notion_api_key.description: Lets the server read and write your Ramble On knowledge base and voice model in Notion. Leave empty to run without Notion.

notion_root_page.title: Ramble On root page ID
notion_root_page.description: ID of the Notion page that holds your Voice Model and other Ramble On pages. Share that page with your Notion integration.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Key for the default translation provider. Also used for audio transcription and video generation.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional. Used when you pick Anthropic as the provider, and as the automatic fallback when the main provider fails.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Used only when you pick OpenAI as the provider.

ai_provider.title: AI provider
ai_provider.description: Which provider runs translation: gemini, anthropic, or openai.
